title: Execution records not persisting between broker and control plane
description: The test-api container received 102 GET /get requests (indicating the broker successfully routed traffic), but the control plane database shows 0 execution records. This suggests a data plumbing issue between the broker and control plane where execution metadata is not being persisted or synced.
symptoms: Downstream service receives requests successfully (102 hits in test-api logs)
Agent receives successful 200 responses from broker
Control plane database shows 0 execution records
Execution history endpoint returns no records
root_cause_hint: Broker is not persisting execution records to control plane database, or the execution record sync mechanism is broken. This could be a message queue issue, database connection issue, or missing event publishing in the broker.
evidence: Observation: 'Test API received requests (102 hits logged in container), indicating traffic reached downstream service despite platform-side record gaps.'
Observation: '[bug] task=make-proxied-request | Verification shows 0 execution records in platform database and 0 successful completions, but test-api container logs show 102 GET /get hits.'

title: Access request workflow not integrated with control plane database
description: Agent narration indicates access request was filed and approved, but no records exist in the platform database. This suggests the access request workflow (likely in the CLI or broker) is not persisting state to the control plane database, or the approval mechanism is not integrated.
symptoms: Agent narration claims access request was filed and approved
Control plane database shows 0 access request records
Agent proceeds with execution despite no database evidence of approval
Toolkit binding appears to work despite no binding records in database
root_cause_hint: Access request workflow may be implemented in CLI or broker without integration to control plane database. Approval may be happening in-memory or in a separate system not synced to the main database.
evidence: Observation: '[blocker] task=add-to-toolkit | Agent lacked credentials:write scope and attempted to use access request flow. Narration indicates approval workflow was followed, but no access request records exist in platform database.'
